data.explanation: The Ordnungsamt (public order office) of Stadt Musterstadt has turned down the request to place a moving container on the street in front of Lindenweg 12, because the sidewalk there is only 1.40 m wide and safe pedestrian passage could not be guaranteed. There is no prior objection (Widerspruch) step available — if you disagree with this decision, you must go straight to filing a lawsuit (Klage) with the administrative court named in the letter, by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the rejection becomes final and the permit cannot be obtained this way. Given the legal wording, it may help to consult a lawyer before the deadline.

items.title: File lawsuit (Klage) against the rejection with the administrative court

date.text: binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.action: File a written lawsuit (Klage) with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, or declare it to the record of the court clerk, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If the lawsuit is not filed in time, the rejection of the Sondernutzungserlaubnis becomes final.

data.summary: The Ordnungsamt of Stadt Musterstadt (Aktenzeichen 32.4-SN-2026-0311) rejected Mara Beispiel's 02.07.2026 application for a special use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) to place a moving container in front of Lindenweg 12, because the sidewalk there is only 1.40 m wide. A lawsuit can be filed directly with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt within one month of notification, as no prior objection procedure applies.
